name: kusabi-codex-notify
description: Register detached kusabi chains and tasks and queue exactly one terminal notification into the originating Codex thread.

kusabi-notify.description: Register a detached kusabi chain or task and queue at most one terminal notification into the originating Codex thread.
kusabi-notify.usage: kusabi-notify --launch -- <chain-detach args> | kusabi-notify --launch-task -- <task-detach args> | kusabi-notify --chain <chainId> --thread <threadId> | kusabi-notify --task <jobId> --thread <threadId>

launch.description: Launch a detached chain via kusabi-companion chain-detach and register its background watcher (model-free launch wrapper).

launchTask.description: Launch a detached task via kusabi-companion task-detach and register its background watcher (model-free launch wrapper).

chain.description: Chain id of an existing detached chain to watch.

task.description: Job id of an existing detached task to watch.

thread.description: Originating Codex thread id to notify on terminal state.

remote.description: Shared Codex app-server endpoint passed to codex queue.
